data.name: Profile
data.title: 列表
data.code:
query Profiles($currentPage: Int = 1, $perPage: Int = 10, $sort: [ProfileSortType!], $search: String, $filter: ProfileFilterType, $rand: Boolean = false) {
  profiles(current_page: $currentPage, per_page: $perPage, sort: $sort, q: $search, filter: $filter, rand: $rand) {
    data {
      id
      avatar
      bio
      birthday
      address
      userId
      isDelete
      weight
      state
      deletedBy
      updatedBy
      createdBy
      deletedAt
      updatedAt
      createdAt
      user {
        ...UsersFields
      }
      
    }
    current_page
    per_page
    total
    total_page
  }
}

data.name: Profile
data.title: 详情
data.code:
query ProfileDetail($id: ID, $search: String, $filter: ProfileFilterType) {
  profile(id: $id, q: $search, filter: $filter) {
    id
    avatar
    bio
    birthday
    address
    userId
    isDelete
    weight
    state
    deletedBy
    updatedBy
    createdBy
    deletedAt
    updatedAt
    createdAt
    user {
      ...UsersFields
    }
    
  }
}
